description: This file contains the implementation of DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor, a class that implements IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor to monitor queue adapter receiver metrics such as message counts, initialization, read, and shutdown statistics, using counters and gauges from the System.Diagnostics.Metrics namespace within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
classes.description: A monitor class for queue adapter receivers that tracks metrics such as initialization, read, shutdown, and message metrics, intended for use with Orleans streaming providers.

methods.name: DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing metrics counters and gauges with provided dimensions, sets up monitoring for queue adapter receiver statistics.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Records the result of an initialization attempt, including success flag, duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Records the success, duration, and exceptions related to a read operation.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Updates the count of messages received and their enqueue ages based on provided enqueue timestamps.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Records the result of a shutdown attempt with duration and exception data.

methods.name: GetOldestMessageReadEnqueueAge
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the oldest message was enqueued.

methods.name: GetNewestMessageReadEnqueueAge
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the newest message was enqueued.

methods.name: GetMessagesReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of messages received.
